summary: Wipro Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing a record date of June 5, 2026 for a tender-offer buyback of up to 600 million equity shares (face value ₹2 each) at ₹250 per share, for an aggregate amount up to ₹15,000 crore. The buyback was approved by the board on April 16, 2026 and by shareholders on May 21, 2026, and will be conducted on a proportionate basis. The filing serves as the equivalent of a U.S. issuer tender offer notice. The price of ₹250 per share implies a premium over the prevailing market price, though the exact premium is not stated. The offer reduces equity overhang and returns capital to shareholders. What to watch: final acceptance ratio and any post-buyback price impact.
